# block-editing

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-001 — A writer switches edit mode and finds it as left](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-001.md) — When a writer clicks the Edit button of a writable preview, or opens a preview in a workspace where edit mode was last on, the Studio SHALL switch edit mode on or off, saving or closing what is open, and start that preview in edit mode unless it cannot edit the file.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-003 — A writer edits the raw Markdown of a block in a framed editor](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-003.md) — When a writer clicks a rendered block in edit mode, the Studio SHALL open a framed editor on that block's raw Markdown, in place of the block, with the caret at the clicked word, the line range of the text, its keys and Done and Cancel buttons, and for a block that comes from an included file open the include directive of the edited document instead.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-006 — Typed text is saved, survives updates and is never lost on leaving](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-006.md) — While a writer types in a block editor, the Studio SHALL write the text into the document shortly after the last keystroke, keep the editor, its text and its caret whatever else changes in the preview, apply Done, Ctrl or Cmd+Enter or leaving the text box as keeping the text and Cancel or Escape as restoring the block, and save and close every open editor before the preview switches to another document.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-008 — A writer types and moves between blocks with text editor keys](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-008.md) — While a block editor has the focus, the Studio SHALL give the keys the behaviour of a text editor, with lists that continue, Tab that indents, selections that wrap, Home and End that jump and undo that stays in the editor, and, when an arrow key is pressed at the edge of the text, save the block and open the editor of the neighbour block.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-011 — A writer adds blocks and starts an empty document from the preview](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-011.md) — When a writer clicks the insert point after a block in edit mode, or opens the preview of a document with no body in edit mode and uses the Start writing button or the Enter key, the Studio SHALL open an empty editor at that place and insert the typed text as a new block with one blank line on each side.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-014 — A writer reorders blocks with arrows, keys and selections](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-014.md) — When a writer clicks an arrow of an insert point or presses Alt+Up or Alt+Down in edit mode, the Studio SHALL move the block, or the selected run of blocks, past its neighbour in one edit, keep it at the same place on the screen and keep the selection.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-016 — A writer selects blocks and copies, cuts and pastes them as Markdown](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-016.md) — When a writer Shift+clicks a block or presses Shift+Up or Shift+Down in edit mode, the Studio SHALL select the run of blocks between the anchor and that block and outline it, and when the writer presses Ctrl or Cmd with C, X or V on that selection, copy the exact Markdown, cut it with one blank separator, or paste the clipboard text as new blocks.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-025 — Preview edits land exactly, in one undo step, keep line endings, or are refused with a reason](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-025.md) — When a writer's edit, move, cut or paste reaches the file, the Studio SHALL change exactly the lines the writer meant as one undo step with the line endings of the document and of the block kept, or refuse it with a reason the writer can read and leave the file and the clipboard as they were.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-026 — Diagnose an editor that closed by itself](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-026.md) — While a block editor is used, the Studio SHALL keep a short trace of editor events for diagnostics.
